mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_id, product_id, quantity, added_at) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{addedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId}
